context.body: An attempted obedience occurs after the authorized moment has passed and against a new command.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The people mourn, confess sin, and announce that they will go to the place the LORD promised.
observations.label: Israel goes up after being told to turn away: action

observations.body: Moses warns that the LORD is not among them; they presume to ascend without Moses or the ark and are struck down by Amalekites and Canaanites.
observations.label: Israel goes up after being told to turn away: response

observations.body: we have sinned · go up · LORD is not among you · presumed · struck down
observations.label: Words in Numbers 14:39–45

payload.posture: Read Numbers 14:39–45 as presumption and later retelling evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Confession and movement toward the land do not make the ascent faithful when the LORD has directed the people back to the wilderness.
payload.title: Israel goes up after being told to turn away
